summary: Case report of femoral artery aneurysm repaired with a Dacron graft; a bulk implant, with no particles studied.

Granulocyte adhesion on vitamin E coated polystyrene culture surfaces; a biomaterial surface study, not particles.
Suture materials compared for testis fixation in rats; polypropylene used as bulk suture, no particles involved.
Case report of combined stent graft and Dacron tube repair of an extensive aortic aneurysm.
Randomised comparison of lipid-lowering strategies and blood pressure control; indexed under a resin drug, unrelated to plastic particles.
Blood storage bag material and oxygen saturation in sickle trait donor blood; a container study, not particle exposure.
Polystyrene spheres templated into inverted colloidal crystal cell scaffolds; the polymer is a fabrication tool.
Styrene-maleic acid micelles used to deliver pirarubicin to tumours; a drug carrier, not an environmental particle.
Exercise programme alongside a polyethylene spinal orthosis in neuromuscular scoliosis; the polymer is a brace.

Randomised trial of ciprofloxacin for polyethylene biliary stent patency; the stent is a bulk device.
Encapsulated myoblasts releasing an anti-idiotypic antibody, with a PET yarn as internal matrix; a device component.

Host response to polypropylene mesh against a collagen implant in rats; bulk mesh, no particulate debris measured.

Aneurysm shrinkage after endovascular repair compared between polyester and ePTFE stent grafts; bulk graft materials.
Alveolar macrophage phagocytosis in lung cancer assayed with fluorescent polystyrene beads; the beads are an inert tracer.
Jejunojejunal obstruction after gastric bypass attributed to non-absorbable Dacron suture; a bulk suture complication.
Sedimentation velocity assay of transglutaminase-driven protein aggregation using protein-coated polystyrene microspheres as probes.
